title: Best Time to Buy and Sell
hints: For each day, the best sale today is `price − cheapest price so far`.
Keep two running values: minimum price and best profit.
A `reduce` over a `(minPrice, best)` tuple does it in one line.
jsBridge: One pass tracking the minimum price so far and the best profit, which reads nicely as a `reduce` over a `(minPrice, best)` tuple. JS would use two `let`s or an object accumulator.

compass.q: Two `let` variables vs a tuple `reduce`: which do you find clearer?
O(n) one pass vs checking all pairs O(n²): how big must n be before O(n²) is noticeable on-device?
Empty or single-price arrays: what should the profit be?
Stocks and crypto apps compute ranges like this for charts. Where else?
